# Curated additions to the embedded Ukrainian dictionary.
#
# `data/wordlists/uk_ua.txt` is regenerated by
# `cargo xtask wordlists fetch`, which now applies the LibreOffice
# `uk_UA.aff` rules to expand stems into all inflected surface
# forms (`мати` → `має`, `маю`, `мають`, `матиму`, …). The huge
# verb-form gap that motivated the 167-line patch on 2026-05-07 is
# closed by the expander itself; this file is back to being the
# escape hatch for what remains:
#
# 1. Modern tech / online vocabulary native Ukrainian speakers type
#    in Cyrillic and Hunspell hasn't caught up with.
# 2. Surface forms the rules genuinely miss — re-run
#    `cargo xtask wordlists fetch`, grep the failed word, add it
#    here. (Current list: none — expander coverage is complete for
#    the top ~1k frequency-ranked verbs.)
#
# `build.rs` merges this list into the uk-UA FST at compile time.
# Format: one lowercase word per line; blank lines and `#`-comments
# ignored. Reload via the tray "Reload Settings" item picks up edits
# at runtime via the user-overlay path — see CLAUDE.md.
